query: SELECT p.id, p.residentId, p.packageType, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.isActive, p.reminderSent, p.expirationEmailSent, r.firstName, r.lastName FROM packages p JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id WHERE p.totalHours - p.usedHours <= 0 ORDER BY p.updatedAt DESC LIMIT 10;
